description: Whole-trip planning tasks for the Chapter 3 policy-optimization example. Each task has one total budget that must cover a flight, a hotel for N nights, and at least the required activities. The objective (agents.travel.score_policy_task) is budget_factor x quality: staying within budget while maximizing nonstop/rating/activity quality. The tools carry good (gotcha-aware) descriptions, so pricing is honest and the only lever is the agent's allocation strategy: a greedy or premium policy either under-delivers quality or busts the budget, while a plan-then-allocate policy fits high quality inside the budget. Tasks span a comfortable control (P3), tight allocation (P1, P5), keep-nonstop-economize-hotel (P2), budget-bust temptation (P4), and an expensive-preference tradeoff (P6).
